results.title: Dhara
results.overview: Deep in the mountains, Sharadha, a Sri Lankan rebel, is seriously injured after attacking an army base and is rescued by the young monk Samitha. While Sharadha recovers in the temple, she and Samitha find their respective beliefs put to the test. Can a rebel woman and a young monk, who embody collective action seeking freedom from oppression and an individual meditation in pursuit of inner freedom, essential needs for survival and uncontrollable desire, coexist in peace in the same space?

results.title: Prince
results.overview: A devoted butler inherits his late employer's mansion - but only until her cherished Afghan Greyhound dies. As he settles in with the dog, greedy relatives scheme to disrupt their peaceful arrangement.

results.title: Joyfull Brasil, starring Maria Alcina
results.overview: When Maria Alcina enters a movie theater, she crosses through the screen itself and is transported into a timeless portal. What follows is a fantastical, musical journey through her life and career, intertwined with defining moments in Brazilian history. Moving between memory, performance, and imagination, the singer revisits her origins and transforms joy into a powerful expression of national identity.

results.title: The Flight
results.overview: On January 8, 2020, Flight PS752 was struck by two surface-to-air missiles, killing everyone on board. Director Soran Mardookhi’s feature documentary The Flight follows the lives of family members left behind as they relentlessly pursue truth, justice and accountability for their loved ones.

results.title: La muerte de Drácula
results.overview: Through a story that combines horror, humor and fantasy, the film starts with the disappearance of Bram Stoker's mythical vampire to discover what happens when one of history's greatest monsters ceases to exist and its legacy passes into the hands of a new generation.

results.title: Another Me: Red Night
results.overview: The short film series "Another Me", created by Armin Lavasani and Parsa Esgandarion, consists of short stories about people who encounter someone who looks exactly like themselves.

results.title: Tunnel 26: The Curse Beneath the Mountain
results.original_title: Tunnel 26: The Curse Beneath the Mountain
results.overview: When an event triggers a blockage of tunnel in a hydro power project in Bhutan, frantic rescue teams from Nepal and Bhutan race against time to save the trapped workers and students unaware that an ancient gate has been unsealed and the survivors are battling not just the rubble, but a rising tide of possession and karmic doom.

results.title: Wen er maar aan
results.overview: Actress M. is facing menopause, loses her long-running role in a crime series, has to deal with an apathetic teenage son, and her sex life is as dry as toast. She tries to reinvent herself, to prove to herself and to the world that she still has a future ahead of her.

results.title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
results.original_title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
results.overview: How far would you go to change a child the world can’t understand? One autistic artist survives a hidden system of abuse built to correct her.

results.title: The Man Who Tickles
results.overview: When a serial tickler terrorises the city, a hard-boiled police detective and his bumbling rookie assistant must discover the truth and put an end to the crimes.

results.title: Pace
results.overview: After serving a prison sentence, 40-year old Malcolm is intent on rebuilding his life. He looks for purpose in his late brother’s passion for running and trains to run a full marathon. Confronted with unresolved family expectations, a judgemental society and destructive self-loathing, can Malcolm keep pace, or will he succumb to the unrelenting tempo of society?

results.title: Velvet Burn
results.overview: A portrait of drag artist Ally Starr.

results.title: Rough Draft
results.overview: Much to his wife’s chagrin, Michael can’t seem to settle on the ending to his latest novel. Even though he has owed the publisher for some time now, he keeps deleting and tweaking the ending to his tale of horror, with each change ultimately affecting the outcome of the group of teens who are being killed one by one by an unknown killer in his story.

results.title: The Tribe
results.overview: Silvano just wants to celebrate his wife Tere's birthday in peace, but his plan is ruined when his chaotic and contentious family shows up.

results.title: LIPOLAS CARNEIROS: O Último Código
results.overview: When a series of mysterious blackouts begins revealing hidden messages across the city, Lipolas Carneiros discovers that his past is connected to a secret project capable of rewriting people's memories. Teaming up with his closest friends, he races to uncover the truth before a powerful organization erases every trace of it. Facing dangerous chases, unexpected betrayals, and impossible choices, the group embarks on a mission that could change their future forever.

results.title: Camouflage
results.overview: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

results.title: Wirbel
results.overview: A dilapidated house stands among the fields in the rolling landscape of the Czech Central Mountains. Its new and only inhabitant is Martin, who left the city to rediscover his lost sense of direction here. But when the mysterious Agnes appears on his doorstep, his secluded world begins to crumble. As the landscape resists and an ancient danger hidden in the soil comes to life, Martin must restore the lost memory of the place to save Agnes, the land, and himself.

results.title: Pat & Mat: Back to the Countryside
results.overview: Pat and Mat return to the countryside—coinciding with the 50th anniversary of their very first television adventure.  At their country retreat, the pair once again dive headlong into a whirlwind of DIY escapades, where there is no shortage of slapstick situations. For every problem, they have a "brilliant" technical solution at the ready.

results.title: GOR
results.overview: WHAT IF YOU GET TO ESCAPE  2 individuals from different state are stuck in a reality they can't escape while they encounter their own something vicious
